ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 3
   C. 7
   D. 6

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

3. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 5

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 25

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 49

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 5

15. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
